# Blocked provider direction

## Destination

Verify the current runtime projection against the external provider checksum.

## Current state

The governing direction is recorded in
[the provider direction](../../docs/provider-direction.md). Verification can
resume when the external checksum in
[U1](unknowns/U1-provider-checksum.md) is available.

## Blockers and dependencies

The provider owner has not yet published the required checksum.

## Ready frontier

No work is ready until the checksum is available. Verification may proceed after
that dependency is resolved.
